name: Khaing Myal Htike
title: AI & Backend Developer
summary: AI and backend developer with four years of experience shipping and running production systems. Built and operate the Python backend behind Magick Box, an AI creative app live on the App Store, Google Play and the web, plus magick_ai, the in-house SDK that gives it chat, image, video, music and podcast generation across seven AI providers. Most recently took Magick Whisper, a Go and Flutter dog-training app, from an empty repository to TestFlight in seven weeks.
